verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for an observability platform, but the evidence pack never documents a user-defined schedule or recurring workflow capability. Synthetic tests (elastic-docs-5) and threshold alert rules (elastic-docs-16) are adjacent features, and none of the quoted text describes the user setting a recurrence interval or cron-style schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
